propositions: A ~1 GiB spent history in the tickets-store must be reclaimed via length-aware git fast-export filter and fast-import rewrite to strip unreachable .bridge_state history that git repack alone cannot compact.
The filtered tickets pack exceeds the CI Verified gate limit (131072 KiB) when changes carry stale bases, causing recurring verification failures until proactive repack/gc headroom is added.

The pre-rewrite diagnostic repair (ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a) must execute before history rewrite to ensure the authoritative store is clean, with zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records verified via rebar fsck.

The rewrite and all mutations (bundle creation, gc/prune, force-with-lease publication, rebar.toml re-pin) must occur only after operator confirmation of zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers, with exact old-tip/new-tip lease verification and rollback bundles pre-staged.

Post-rewrite identity-report equivalence (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered multisets and stderr counts) must match pre-rewrite baseline, and enforce_since must be re-pinned through Gerrit before writers resume.
